newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido aims to nearly double sales in Americas.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido aims to nearly double sales in Americas.

text.p: Shiseido Co Ltd said on Monday it is aiming to nearly double its sales in the Americas by 2000 and had set up a regional headquarters there to improve efficiency.
Japan's leading cosmetics maker said the headquarters was established within its wholly owned U.S. subsidiary, Shiseido America Inc.
"By 2000 the company expects total overseas sales to be 1.8 times more than they are today," a Shiseido spokeswoman said.
She said current sales in the American continent account for 20 percent of Shiseido's total overseas sales on a wholesale basis, but declined to give a specific figure.
"We want the regional headquarters to make business decisions on its own, instead of having Tokyo control everything," the spokeswoman said.
The new system would allow the company to localise decision-making, thus making it faster and more effective, she added.
The spokeswoman said the Americas headquarters would hire about 35 local staff and begin to operate in January 1998.
